summary.short: Adds Chapter V to the Reglamento de la Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor (arts. 37 Bis to 37 Nonies) on technological protection measures, rights management information, and online service providers' notice-and-takedown procedures. Signed 28 August 2026; enters into force 90 business days after publication in the DOF.
summary.long: The decree adds Chapter V to Title IV of the Reglamento de la Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor. Article 37 Bis makes protection of technological protection measures and rights management information independent of copyright protection, and excludes circumvention where the related content is not protected under the Ley. Article 37 Ter defines 'material' and 'contenido' by reference to protected works, performances, phonograms, broadcasts and artists' images and voices. Articles 37 Quáter and 37 Septies list required contents of notices and counter-notices, including sworn statements and acknowledgment of the sanction under Article 232 Quinquies of the Ley. Article 37 Quinquies bars online service providers from conditioning the removal step on registration certificates or other documentation, except for counter-notices. Article 37 Sexies requires providers to make a notice form available to users. Article 37 Octies requires providers to notify the original notifier of a counter-notice. Article 37 Nonies sets restoration of disputed content within 10 to 15 business days where requirements are met, and requires removal again if the original notifier shows a proceeding was started within 15 business days. Transitional provisions apply prior rules to notices filed before entry into force and provide that implementation costs are borne by existing budgets.</parameter>

notes: The document is the decree text only. It gives no DOF publication date. Transitorio Primero sets entry into force 90 días hábiles after DOF publication, so no entry-into-force date is computed. Registry metadata (DOF 24-09-2026) is not from the document and is not used. Signed 28 August 2026 per the text. Transitorio Segundo: notices and counter-notices filed before entry into force follow the rules in force when filed. Art. 37 Nonies sets two separate periods: 10 to 15 días hábiles for reinstatement, and a window of no more than 15 días hábiles for the original complainant to show proceedings; these are not in conflict. The target Reglamento and laws are not in the registry, so target_instrument_id is empty.

thresholds.note: The decree contains no numeric cutoffs that change legal treatment. The numbers present are article numbers and procedural time limits: Art. 37 Nonies gives 10 to 15 business days for re-enabling contested content and 15 business days for initiating proceedings, and the Primero transitorio gives 90 business days before entry into force. Per the codebook, these are events or deadlines, not thresholds.
